title: Como interested in Manchester United’s Zirkzee following long-term Kean setback
snippet: Reports in Italy claim that Como have joined a list of Serie A sides interested...
body: MANCHESTER, ENGLAND - AUGUST 16: Joshua Zirkzee of Manchester United celebrates scoring his team's first goal with teammate Marcus Rashford during the Premier League match between Manchester United FC and Fulham FC at Old Trafford on August 16, 2024 in Manchester, England. (Photo by Michael Regan/Getty Images) Reports in Italy claim that Como have joined a list of Serie A sides interested in Manchester United and former Bologna attacker Joshua Zirkzee following a long-term set-back for Italy international Moise Kean in his recovery from injury. Cesc Fabregas confirmed over the weekend that Kean is set to be sidelined for another few months , ‘not weeks’, following a set-back in training towards the end of last week. Kean has been struggling with a recurring tibia issue for many months, a problem that has affected him for several months, before the completion of his €40m transfer to Como over the summer. Since the summer, Kean has played through pain but has had set-backs along the way: His most recent appearance came for the Italy national team during the September-October international break. Just as he was due to return to full training with Como, Kean suffered another setback, which may now require surgical intervention, and is expected to keep him out of action for another few months. According to Monday’s reports from Gianluca Di Marzio , the setback suffered by Kean could lead Como to intervene in the January transfer window, and Manchester United’s Zirkzee could be a p
summary_en: Kean suffered a training setback expected to keep him out for several more months, prompting Como interest in Zirkzee.
